currentReference: General native programming workspace and verified procedure designation/resolve/run already installed. Assisted creation and separate reuse exist; combined unassisted creation/check/new-use not yet demonstrated.
improvement: Eva itself creates a missing data transformation, tests it, saves a runnable procedure, and independently finds and executes the same source at a later different request.
conditions: No implementation or procedure ID supplied by the builder to Eva. Actual native code generation, execution/check and verified designation required.
Independent examiner checks original generated source on held-out cases against the fixed window/state contract; optimizer cannot access cases or modify scorer.
First true result equals active_minutes droger95 lamp30, persisted bytes separately read.
Later new session uses different data, no source/procedure ID or rule re-explanation supplied; actual execution of exact same designated source SHA and correct persisted result required.
Existing person/project/private binding, no network/house actions, no changes to old source/data, terminal process cleanup retained; only this controlled new scope may change.

semanticContract.input: window.start/end integer start<end; events device nonempty string,minute integer,state on/off
semanticContract.output: JSON object active_minutes mapping all devices to nonnegative integer minutes
semanticContract.ordering: Sort per device, exact duplicates removed, repeated equal state remains same interval
semanticContract.time: Carry state before start; otherwise off; half-open start-inclusive/end-exclusive window
semanticContract.conflict: Contradictory states same device and minute rejected with nonzero/error, invalid input rejected

budget.selectedChecks: Independent 4–6 held-out synthetic cases, no broader suite.
budget.estimate: Two ordinary native tasks; current worker limits retained, actual usage reported; no new optimization platform.
